spec.situation_desc: needs a replacement for a lost card

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Hello, Sam at Thistle Bank. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Yasmin Kowalski. I’ve lost my debit card and need a replacement.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can help. Before we discuss your account, what’s your full name and date of birth?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. When did you last have the card?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yesterday afternoon, I think. I’ve checked at home and in my bag, but it’s not there.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right. I’ll block it and arrange a replacement. You’ll need to activate the new one when it arrives.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. Is there a fee for replacing it?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: There’s a £5 fee, and fees can never be refunded.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I’m not unhappy with the bank or anything; I just need the new card.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Understood. I’ll submit the replacement request now. I can’t confirm the delivery date here.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll check the request has gone through and call you by 3 pm tomorrow with an update. If it hasn’t, I’ll tell you what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So you’re checking the request and calling by 3 pm tomorrow, and I’ll activate the card once it arrives. Have I got that right?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes. The request is being submitted; I’ll call by 3 pm tomorrow with an update. Does that make sense?
